scope: Independent read-only review of preparation, frozen input/dependency closure, matrix identities, lifecycle assertions and evidence interpretation. No full matrix/browser/map execution. Root authored and repaired all three reviewed tools.

resolvedFindings.problem: The earlier presentation harness could report pass for a subset or stale compiled catalog; expectedCases/unsetEnvironment were only preparation metadata.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Preparation now compiles QA_MATRIX_FINAL as1. The final harness rejects QA_WORLDS, checks the real compiled108 catalog against the fixed-plan IDs, binds the plan SHA, checks unique8 directions/6 phases, and requires the complete unique15552 Cartesian set. Capability binds the same fixed plan and verifies all1536 unique expected labels. Pilot reports are explicitly partial-author-scope.

checks.runtimeSource: Source manifest verifiedCopyHashes=true and patches=[]; every frozen listed file SHA checked before and after preparation. Runtime/data symlinks resolve into that frozen copy.
checks.harnessAndDependencies: Harness, Phaser stub and exact qualification plan are separately copied and hashed. Every esbuild input must match either its copied harness/stub receipt or one frozen runtime source entry; no live application file can silently enter the accepted dependency list.
checks.capabilityCoverage: 12 ordinary core families ×8 directions ×4 lifecycle time samples ×4 synthetic topologies =1536. These are controlled real-runtime fixtures, not108-world actual tool-use journeys.
checks.presentationCoverage: 108 actual authored worlds ×3 grades ×8 directions ×6 phases =15552. Each world/grade is generated once, then a recorded renderer checks restore/next-frame equality, pause, teardown and unchanged terrain/mesh data.
checks.immutableExecutionBoundary: Preparation emits prepared-not-run. Coordinator must still verify the declared source/plan/executor hashes before and after each actual process and preserve original exits/reports. This review grants no matrix execution pass.

negativeContract.method: Extract and transpile the actual harness selection-prefix expressions, with the same esbuild final define; no mirrored selection algorithm and no runtime/map imports.

audioBoundary: Each fresh presentation starts directly at a selected phase. MasterMaterialAudio anti-backlog consumes an unobserved partial cycle, so these samples establish serializable audio clocks/state and restored frame consistency, not a complete loading→stress→release event sequence, audible quality, or listening approval.
otherLimits: Recorded graphics/renderer do not validate native pixel quality or GPU execution.
Controlled pause is a no-tick/setMotion contract, not physical browser pause-key input.
Neither the fake-input coverage checks nor this review count as game journeys, qualification cases or enabled-world approval.
